scenarios.name: Scroll the floating ribbon group list

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the floating 3D Model ribbon shows Start 2D Sketch above the lower groups
the user scrolls down in the floating ribbon group list
Start 2D Sketch scrolls out of view
Shape Generator, Work Features, Pattern, and Create Freeform are visible
